subject.title: feat: configure metadata (contextWindow, maxTokens, etc.) for custom provider setup

question: After the metadata-preservation fixes, should OpenClaw accept a configure-only custom-provider metadata editor for the broader interactive setup request, or wait for a unified onboarding/configure design?
rationale: The patch adds a new setup/config editing surface for persisted provider model metadata, and repository policy treats provider routing, setup workflows, and persisted model config as compatibility-sensitive product surfaces.

options.title: Repair and review configure-only scope
options.body: Fix the preservation bugs first, then let maintainers decide whether this configure-time editor is the accepted slice of the canonical metadata request.

options.title: Pause for unified setup design
options.body: Hold this PR until onboarding, configure, and non-interactive setup share one approved model-metadata direction.

options.title: Close in favor of the canonical issue
options.body: Close this branch if maintainers do not want a standalone configure editor and instead want a fresh implementation from the canonical tracker.

recommendation.title: Repair and review configure-only scope
recommendation.body: Fix the preservation bugs first, then let maintainers decide whether this configure-time editor is the accepted slice of the canonical metadata request.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent provider/configuration work and custom-provider context-limit repairs make this the strongest routing signal for the product-surface decision.
